meta.title: Valsora's 2036 tech tree: a mockup
meta.status: A mockup for the author to react to. Not in the mod.

eras.name: Cold War
eras.desc: Cold War I (1965) and Cold War II (1985): the floor of the tree, kit of the 1960s to the 1980s. Feudal and levy states start with Cold War I, developing nations with Cold War II.

eras.name: Modern
eras.desc: Modern I (2005) and Modern II (2025): today's kit, what most nations field. Modern II is what the base game gives its minor nations at the start.
The game's first years: the superpowers start with part of it (the base game's majors start with its 1936 technologies), everyone else researches it first.

eras.name: Next generation
eras.desc: Ahead of everyone: late, costly, and penalised as ahead of its time until its year. The base game's three-year rhythm: big steps in 2039, 2042, 2045, upgrades between.

tiers.name: Feudal and levy states
tiers.desc: Cold War I: the floor of every main line (Rouental's vassal levies).

tiers.name: Modern (default)
tiers.desc: Up to Modern II: today's kit. Every nation the author doesn't place elsewhere.

tiers.name: Superpowers
tiers.desc: Modern II and part of 2036, the nuclear technologies and a few warheads: Krionik, the Kampfian Empire, Sarkis and Fraxhemark.

folders.name: Infantry
folders.blurb: Small arms and the soldier's kit, the trucks and fighting vehicles that carry them, and the specialists.

folders.name: Support
folders.blurb: The companies that make a division work: engineers, drones, police, maintenance, medics, logistics, signals and electronic warfare, air defence; and the railways.

folders.name: Artillery
folders.blurb: Air defence, howitzers, rocket artillery and anti-armour missiles.

folders.name: Armour
folders.blurb: The tank designer's chassis, engines and armour: light tanks, main battle tanks, heavy assault tanks, and what the Assault Mech project unlocks.
folders.dlc: No Step Back (without it: Armour, classic)

folders.name: Naval
folders.blurb: The ship designer's hulls, from the Cold War's gun battleship and missile battlecruiser to the arsenal ship, with the sensors and anti-submarine weapons that go with them.

folders.name: Naval Systems
folders.blurb: What goes on the hulls: guns, missiles and lasers, combat systems and damage control; sealift, replenishment and mines.
folders.dlc: Man the Guns (without it, in the classic Naval folder)

folders.name: Air
folders.blurb: The plane designer's airframes, all jets from the start (fighters, drones, strike aircraft, bombers, airlifters), their missiles and bombs, and their engines.
folders.dlc: By Blood Alone (without it: Air, classic)

folders.name: Electronics
folders.blurb: Networks, radar, computing and military AI, combat systems, cyber defence and offence; fortifications; missiles and nuclear research.

folders.name: Industry
folders.blurb: Production, construction, resources, fuel and the synthetics that replace what a nation can't import.

folders.name: Special Projects
folders.blurb: Projects at the special project facilities: anyone can run them, but they are hard, slow and dear. Four specialisations, as in the game; the nuclear one also holds space.
folders.dlc: Götterdämmerung (without it: no special projects; their outputs are ordinary technologies where they can be)
